connector.name: Devilge
connector.registryDescription: Android/KMM MCP server: logcat, ADB device control, Compose previews, network, Maestro flows.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package devilge. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the yercko account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: DEVILGE_ANDROID_PROJECT_ROOT
env.description: Absolute path to the Android/KMM project root that devilge inspects (Gradle modules, source files, build outputs).

env.name: DEVILGE_OUTPUTS_ROOT
env.description: Directory where devilge writes screenshots and UI dumps. Defaults to <projectRoot>/.devilge-outputs/.

env.name: DEVILGE_DEFAULT_DEVICE_SERIAL
env.description: Default ADB serial used when a tool does not specify one. Useful when several devices/emulators are attached.

env.name: DEVILGE_FLOWS_ROOT
env.description: Directory containing Maestro YAML flows. Defaults to <projectRoot>/devilge-flows/.

env.name: DEVILGE_MAESTRO_BIN_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to the Maestro binary. If unset, devilge resolves it from PATH; if absent, Maestro tools degrade gracefully.

env.name: DEVILGE_ALLOW_FLOW_SCRIPTS
env.description: Set to 'true' to allow Maestro flows containing 'runScript:' blocks. Default is false; flows with scripts are rejected.

env.name: DEVILGE_HTTP_LOG_TAGS
env.description: Comma-separated logcat tags scanned for HTTP traffic. Defaults to 'HttpClient,OkHttp' (covers Ktor + OkHttp/Retrofit).

env.name: DEVILGE_HTTP_LOG_FORMAT
env.description: HTTP log parser to use: 'auto' (default), 'ktor', or 'okhttp'.
